name: herdr
verification: This file is the single source of the pin. scripts/fetch-herdr-runtime.sh downloads and verifies the asset against it for every app build and e2e run, and desktop/scripts/package.mjs ships that verified binary inside hide.app. contracts/herdr-api.schema.json is the schema this binary reports. Change both with scripts/bump-herdr.sh <release-tag>, never by hand.
